related_work_items.paper_title: High-resolution image synthesis with latent diffusion models

evidence.evidence_text: Stable Diffusion (SD) [30] made this technology more accessible by introducing latent space compression, enabling efficient high-resolution synthesis.

As a state-of-the-art approach for text-to-image generation, SD [30] establishes itself as an effective framework for generative modeling. In this paper, we adopt SD as the foundational architecture due to its demonstrated effectiveness in conditional image generation.

related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: Stable Diffusion is the direct generative foundation Neptune-X extends, so it is central to the method lineage rather than the main comparative gap argument.

related_work_items.paper_title: A joint ship detection and waterway segmentation method for environment-aware of usvs in canal waterways

evidence.evidence_text: Object detection is a fundamental technology for maritime environmental perception ... including autonomous or assisted navigation for surface ships [43], intelligent video surveillance for coastal facilities [40], and autonomous inspection using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) [44].

Maritime scenes demand an explicit semantic understanding of the interaction between objects and their aquatic surroundings, as objects and environmental context (e.g., sea states, reflections, lighting) are closely intertwined in both appearance and meaning.

related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: This cited maritime detection work helps establish the application domain and motivates environment-aware maritime perception, which Neptune-X targets through data generation rather than detector-only design.

evidence.section: Comparison of Different Sampling Methods in Data Augmentation.
evidence.evidence_text: To comprehensively demonstrate the advantages of the proposed AAS method, extensive comparative experiments were conducted with five different active learning approaches.

related_work_items.gap_relevance_note: The paper draws directly on active-learning-style sample selection ideas for AAS while arguing that standard active learning does not account for synthetic-data utility and maritime attribute difficulty.
